'''Blue Squadron''' was an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that participated in the [[Battle of Byss]].

==History==
When the Alderaanian Resistance discovered that the [[Sarlacc Project]], a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] project to construct a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype]], was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], a combined Resistance and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was dispatched to destroy the prototype. Blue Squadron was formed to participate in the battle and was cobbled together from a number of different smuggler starfighters. It was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Adrian Verana]] of the Resistance, and the Resistance officer Captain [[Sirona Okeefe]] was also a member of it. The squadron fought during the battle and after suffering some casualties, the eleven surviving starfighters flew into the superstructure of the Star Destroyer and destroyed it.
